'''Boris Andreevich Arbuzov''' ({{langx|ru|Борис Андреевич Арбузов}}; born 12 May 1938) is a Russian physicist known for his contribution to theoretical [[elementary particle physics]] and [[quantum field theory]].<ref name="enc_niiyaf">{{cite book
 |author      = 
 |title       = ''"Arbuzov, Boris Andreevich"'', In: Encyclopedia of Moscow University. Skobeltsyn Institute of Nuclear Physics
 |url         = 
 |location    = Moscow
 |publisher   = Biblion — Russkaya kniga
 |page        = 169
 |year        = 2006
 |isbn        = 978-5-902005-05-6
 |access-date = 
 |language    = ru
}}</ref>

==Biography==
Boris Arbuzov was born on 12 May 1938 in [[Moscow]]. His father was Major General Andrei Ivanovich Arbuzov (1908—1979), known expert in the [[Precision bombing|precision-bombing]] theory.<ref name="vvia">{{cite encyclopedia
 | title        = Arbuzov, Andrei Ivanovich
 | encyclopedia = Large electronic encyclopedia of [[Zhukovsky Air Force Engineering Academy]]
 | publisher    = nasledie-vvia.ru
 | url          = http://nasledie-vvia.ru/index.php?id=15&id_wiki_user=30
 | language     = ru
 | accessdate   = 2015-05-11
}}</ref>

After finishing the school Boris Arbuzov started his studies at [[MSU Faculty of Physics|Faculty of Physics]] of [[Moscow State University]], which he graduated in 1961.<ref name="fizfak">{{cite web
 | title      = Faculty of Physics Alumni of 1961
 | website    = 
 | author     = 
 | publisher  = Faculty of Physics Alumni Union — upmsu.phys.msu.ru
 | url        = http://upmsu.phys.msu.ru/div1961.html
 | language   = ru
 | date       = 
 | accessdate = 2015-05-11
}}</ref>

From 1962 to 1965 Arbuzov worked at [[Joint Institute for Nuclear Research]] in [[Dubna]], [[Moscow Region]], as a researcher of the Laboratory of Theoretical Physics. In 1965 he successfully defended his doctoral ([[Candidate of Sciences|C.Sc.]]) thesis entitled ''On expandability of the S-matrix in powers of the coupling constant in quantum field theory''.<ref name="enc_niiyaf" />

In 1966 Boris Arbuzov moved to [[Institute for High Energy Physics]] in [[Protvino]], [[Moscow Region]], where he worked as a senior researcher, and then as a director of laboratory and a principal researcher. In 1970 Arbuzov successfully defended his [[Doktor nauk|D.Sc.]] thesis devoted to ''Geometrical schemes of the interaction of elementary particles''.<ref name="enc_niiyaf" />

From 1973 to 1993 Arbuzov was a member of the Scientific Council on [[Neutrino|Neutrino Physics]] of the [[Academy of Sciences of the USSR]] (later — [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]).<ref name="enc_niiyaf" />

From 1999 Boris Arbuzov has worked at Institute of Nuclear Physics of Moscow State University as a leading researcher of the Division of Theoretical High Energy Physics. From 1973 he has been teaching a course in ''Theory of Elementary Particles'' at the [[MSU Faculty of Physics|Faculty of Physics]] of Moscow State University. He became a professor in 1980.<ref name="enc_niiyaf" />

==Research==
The main scientific results of Boris Arbuzov are related to studies of [[non-perturbative]] effects in [[quantum field theory]], and also to development of the corresponding methods to describe the interactions between elementary particles. In particular, these methods have been applied to [[spontaneous symmetry breaking]] in [[electroweak interaction]], as well as to solving the [[Schwinger–Dyson equation]]s for [[Green's function]]s in [[quantum chromodynamics]].<ref name="enc_niiyaf" />

* B.A. Arbuzov, A.A. Logunov, A.N. Tavkhelidze, and R.N. Faustov, ''[http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0031916362902214 The asymptotic behavior of the scattering amplitudes and the renormalisation group method]'', [[Physics Letters]], 1962, 2, No.3, p.&nbsp;150—152.
* B.A. Arbuzov and A.A. Logunov, ''[http://iopscience.iop.org/0038-5670/20/11/A05 Structure of elementary particles and relationships between the different forces of nature]'', [[Soviet Physics Uspekhi]], 20, p.&nbsp;956—969, 1977.
* A.I. Alekseev, B.A. Arbuzov and V.A. Baykov, ''[https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF01018412 Infrared asymptotic behavior of gluon Green's functions in quantum chromodynamics]'', [[Theoretical and Mathematical Physics]], 52, No.2, p.&nbsp;739—746, 1982.
* B.A. Arbuzov, E.E. Boos, and A.I. Davydychev, ''[https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF01886478 Infrared asymptotics of gluon Green's functions in covariant gauge]'', [[Theoretical and Mathematical Physics]], 74, No.2, p.&nbsp;103—108, 1988.
* B.A. Arbuzov, [[Victor Savrin|V.I. Savrin]], and S.A. Shichanin, ''[http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0370269392908663 On a mechanism of GSI resonance production]'', [[Physics Letters]], B275, No.1—2, p.&nbsp;144—148, 1992.
* Boris A. Arbuzov, ''[http://www.degruyter.com/view/product/203910 Non-perturbative effective interactions in the Standard Model]'' (225 pages), De Gruyter Studies in Mathematical Physics, v.23, Berlin, [[Walter de Gruyter]], 2014, {{ISBN|978-3-11-030292-9}}.
